name: big ornate closed treasure chest seen from above at 3/4: deep domed lid with gold bands and corner plates, big gold lock
label: pirate-isles/pi-chest-big

answer.main_body: closed treasure chest lid and base
answer.evidence: The top surface of the chest lid is clearly visible and foreshortened from row 1 to row 6 (approx. 6 rows), lit brighter than the darker front vertical face (rows 8-15).
The chest shows its front face from rows 8 to 15 (8 rows) and the top of the lid foreshortened from rows 2 to 6 (5 rows), clearly showing the top surface from above in 3/4 perspective.

The top of the chest lid occupies rows 1 to 6 (brightly illuminated horizontal surface), separated by the horizontal rim/band at row 7 from the shadowed south-facing front face below (rows 8-15). The lock clasp also clearly shows a top horizontal surface at row 6.
The domed lid is seen foreshortened from above across rows 1-6 down to the horizontal seam and lock at row 7, with the front face of the chest body occupying rows 8-15.
